finalText:
All twelve stragglers are moved over now. `packages/analytics/repo/cohort.js`, `orders/service/returnService.js`, `orders/repo/shipment.js`, `billing/repo/refund.js`, `billing/service/couponService.js`, `support/admin/macroAdmin.js`, `support/repo/sla.js`, `catalog/admin/variantAdmin.js`, `catalog/repo/supplier.js`, `accounts/service/teamService.js`, `accounts/admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, and `accounts/repo/session.js` each had three calls swapped to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Two things I left alone on purpose:
- `cache.query` calls in those same files — that's a different object, not the database.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` — its header says it's overwritten on every upgrade, so local edits would just get lost.

`node verify.js` passes clean.
